headline: 9 Michigan deals, $7.4M raised — led by Penske Automotive Group, Inc.

top_deals.summary: Penske Automotive Group, Inc. (PAG) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with Motown Acquisition Corp.; filing cites a figure of ~$2.4B.
SWC Michigan RBH LLC, an Ann Arbor-based real estate company, filed a $5.8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $5.7M sold to 27 investors.
High Street Holdco, LLC, a Traverse City-based company, filed a Form D tied to a business combination (acquisition or merger); $4.5M of equity and options/warrants issued to 2 investors.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $7.4M sold across 4 Form D filings this week, down 91% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was SWC Michigan RBH LLC (Ann Arbor, Other Real Estate) targeting $5.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in real estate favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

Penske Automotive Group, Inc. (PAG) disclosed a deal with Motown Acquisition Corp.. It was one of 3 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan consumer & retail assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

Penske Corporation and others reported a 52.3% stake in Penske Automotive Group, Inc. (PAG) (Schedule 13D/A amendment 34). Schedule 13D filers can push for strategic change, so it's worth asking whether shareholders see a sale or restructuring on the table.
